entries.summary: Created sample Python tutorial videos and uploaded to course. Each lesson has a video that gets split into segments.
entries.details: Created 11 sample videos for Python for Beginners course. Videos are simple colored backgrounds (1280x720) with duration 15-30 seconds each. Uploaded to lessons 4-14. Videos split into segments (1 segment each since duration < 60s). No GitHub account connected, so segments saved locally.
entries.code:
python create_sample_videos.py

# Creates videos using ffmpeg:
# ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i color=c=0x1a1a2e:s=1280x720:d=15 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast output.mp4

# Uploaded to lessons:
# - What is Python? (15s)
# - Installing Python (15s)
# - Your First Program (20s)
# - Variables (20s)
# - Strings (20s)
# - Numbers and Math (20s)
# - If/Else Statements (30s)
# - For Loops (30s)
# - While Loops (25s)
# - Defining Functions (30s)
# - Default Arguments (20s)
decisions: Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{course-slug}
Each lesson is a folder: lesson-{id}-{title}
User can override segment_duration via API (30-3600 seconds)
YouTube-like player with auto-play, progress bar, chapters sidebar
Streaming proxy fetches from GitHub on-demand, no local storage
Loading indicator shows when fetching from GitHub
Preload next segment 10 seconds before current ends
Questions appear at specific timestamps, video pauses
AI agent explains wrong answers with retry option
